note: Synthetic policy for the proof of concept. Thresholds are set by the bank's fraud policy owner, not by the AI model.

amount_tiers.description: Amount is at least 3x the customer's average
Amount is at least 5x the customer's average
Amount is at least 10x the customer's average

rules.description: Device not seen before for this customer
Transaction city differs from home city
IP country differs from home country
3 or more transactions in the last hour
Account is less than 30 days old
Customer KYC risk category is high

hard_rules.description: Amount 10x average with a new device or foreign IP
New account paying a new beneficiary with high velocity (mule pattern)

data_floors.description: Critical evidence missing (device or IP): case cannot be auto-cleared
Possible instruction injection in free text: case cannot be auto-cleared
